note: Rules the payroll run needs beyond the 5b pack (batch 5c). Loaded by two staff through the console flow (scripts/load-rule-pack.ts, the seed). Every set marked verify until the compliance owner and the partner CA confirm it.

ruleSets.source: Industrial Employment (Standing Orders) Act, 1946 s.10A(1): subsistence allowance during suspension pending enquiry, half of the wages for the first ninety days and three-fourths thereafter (higher amounts under state rules or standing orders prevail).

golden.name: 10 days at 1,000 a day within the first 90
Crossing day 90: 5 days at half, 5 at three-fourths

ruleSets.source: Maternity Benefit Act, 1961 s.5(1) and (3) (as amended in 2017): the average daily wage for each day of actual absence, up to 26 weeks; not payable by the employer where the ESI Act covers the woman (s.2(1), ESI Act s.50).

golden.name: 20 days at an average of 800 a day
ESI covers her: nothing from the employer

ruleSets.source: Employees' Compensation Act, 1923 s.4(1)(d) and 4(2): temporary disablement is paid half-monthly at 25% of monthly wages (waiting period of 3 days unless the disablement lasts 28 days or more); ESI-covered injuries are paid by the ESIC (ESI Act s.53).

golden.name: Half a month (15 days) on 30,000 a month: 7,500
